description: Fetch one ProductGuru record by the id that search returned: 'p:<ean>' for a product (name, brand/maker, category, recorded attributes, linked recall notices) or 'r:<recall>' for an official recall notice (issuing agency, date, summary, link to the authority's notice). Returns id, title, text, url and metadata. Factual data only.
name: fetch
title: ProductGuru fetch (one product or recall notice)
